blockdesc-glint: Glass the Crystalline Chisel carved to hold a crystal. A charged Life crystal set in it lights it as a torch does, dimming as its charge runs down.
glint-set: Set a Life crystal in it, or take it out with an empty hand
glint-lifeonly: Only a Life crystal seats in a Glint
glint-notlife: Its crystal is not Life: it gives no light.
journal-fourmysteries-page1:
The Four Mysteries

Four more colours wait in the stone: Life and Death, Time and Rust. Each wants two things together: the right kind of place, and a sign of itself set within two blocks of the crystal. A sign in the wrong place does nothing, and the right place without its sign does nothing.

They pair off as the Elementals do: Life against Death, Time against Rust. And every crystal now gives only a faint light, brighter as it fills.
journal-fourmysteries-page2:
Life, white-yellow.

1. Set the cradle among living things: crops, saplings, berry bushes, potted plants or animals. Ten of them are a full sign.
2. Give it light: open daylight, or torches and lamps beside it for the night.

A greenhouse bed: refines by day. With torches in the bed: day and night. My own crystals' light does not count.
journal-fourmysteries-page3:
Death, black-purple.

1. Set the cradle in the dark: no daylight, no lamp within two blocks.
2. Beside it, bony remains or a carcass, or a chest of bones: four bony remains, or 64 bones, are a full sign.
3. Keep Earth out: less than 8 blocks of rock overhead, or walls of wood.

One bony remains: a quarter speed. A creature dying within 8 blocks: an hour at full speed, day or night.
journal-fourmysteries-page4:
Time, light cyan, and Rust, dark rust.

Time: a roofed room on steady ground, with two temporal gears in a chest or on a shelf beside the cradle. A temporal storm stills it.

Rust: a room lined with wood, far below ground where the world is unsteady, with a chest of 64 rot or 16 rusty gears beside the cradle. During a temporal storm the same chest works in any roofed room.
journal-fourmysteries-page5:
Bloom (Life). Aim at a plant and cast.

A crop, berry bush or fruit tree moves on one stage of its growing; a sapling or a planted tree seed loses a day. Each plant takes it once a day, whether my hand or a machine gives it.

Small crystal: one plant. Glowing: a flat patch three by three. Over-driven: a cube three across.
journal-fourmysteries-page6:
Wither (Death). Aim at a plant or the ground and cast.

A crop dies on its farmland; saplings, tall grass, flowers, ferns and leaves wilt away and drop what they would; grass leaves the soil bare.

Glowing: a flat patch three by three, and every creature and person standing in it but me withers too: a little hurt every five breaths for thirty, and another cast starts the thirty again. Over-driven: a cube three across, no harder.
journal-fourmysteries-page7:
Rewind (Time). Aim at a chest, a barrel, food on the ground or set down, and cast.

Food spoiling there turns back half a day, never fresher than new. Only spoiling turns back: a ripe cheese stays ripe.

Small crystal: half a day, one container. Glowing: a whole day, a flat patch three by three. Over-driven: two days, a cube three across. What anyone carries is never touched.
journal-fourmysteries-page8:
Progress (Rust). Aim as for Rewind and cast.

Every slow change moves on: raw cheese ripens, pemmican dries, hides cure, food spoils toward rot for the compost, and a sealed barrel comes closer to done.

Small crystal: half a day, one container. Glowing: a whole day, a flat patch three by three. Over-driven: two days, a cube three across. What anyone carries is never touched.
journal-fourmysteries-page9:
Glint, a lamp.

1. Set a block of glass down.
2. Strike it with the Crystalline Chisel: it becomes a Glint.
3. Right-click a charged Life crystal into it. An empty hand takes the crystal out.

It burns for about twelve days on a full crystal and refills where Life leads, so a Glint in a greenhouse fills by day. No Death crystal within three blocks.

Small crystal: as bright as a candle and more. Glowing: as a torch.
journal-fourmysteries-page10:
In machines a Mystery crystal works as an Elemental does.

Gather: drinks where its Mystery leads, sign and all. Refine: copies it onto the Unaligned crystals beside it. Focus: works its evocation on what it faces, for a tenth of a cast, only when something changes. Scatter: the same over nine by nine, one Evolution weaker.

A Time Focus facing a chest: kept fresh for about 2 a day. A Life Focus facing a field: each plant once a day.
